Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.按函数名或用途搜索 27 个常用 Excel 函数，每条都给出语法模板、可直接粘: Search 27 common Excel functions by name or usage. Every entry includes a syntax template, a copy-ready example, sample data, an expected result and version support, with bilingual keywords, category filters and local CSV export.
map.页面收录汇总、统计、逻辑、查找、文本与动态数组六类函数。搜索会匹配函数名、中英文: The page covers math, statistical, logical, lookup, text and dynamic-array functions. Search matches function names, Chinese and English descriptions, categories and common aliases such as “conditional count”, “lookup” and “average”, and trims leading/trailing spaces. Category buttons combine with the query. The result count is shown, and no-result states offer clear and suggested keywords.
map.在顶部搜索框输入函数名或用途，例如 SUMIFS、「条件计数」或 average: Type a function name or usage into the search box, such as SUMIFS, “conditional count” or average; use category buttons to narrow the list.
map.在条目中先看「语法模板」了解参数顺序，再看「示例公式」和「示例数据」；示例是可直: Read the syntax template for parameter order, then the example formula and sample data. The example is a complete copy-ready formula, and the expected result helps you verify it.
map.点「复制语法模板」或「复制示例公式」，到 Excel 中把示例区域替换成自己的单: Click “Copy syntax” or “Copy example”, then replace the sample ranges with your cells in Excel. If copying fails, the page selects the text for Ctrl+C.
map.需要离线留存时点「导出当前结果 CSV」，导出内容跟随当前搜索和分类，中文/英文: Click “Export filtered CSV” to keep results offline. The export follows the current query and category, and the headers match the page language.
map.做月度销售报表时，搜索「多条件求和」找到 SUMIFS，复制示例后替换地区、月份: For a monthly sales report, search “multi-condition sum” to find SUMIFS, copy the example and replace the region, month and sales ranges.
map.升级 Excel 前搜索 XLOOKUP、FILTER、UNIQUE，核对版本标: Before upgrading Excel, search XLOOKUP, FILTER and UNIQUE and check the version badge; older versions can use INDEX+MATCH, VLOOKUP or helper columns.
map.清洗系统导出的文本时，用 TRIM 去多余空格、SUBSTITUTE 去分隔符、: When cleaning exported text, use TRIM for extra spaces, SUBSTITUTE for separators and LEFT/RIGHT/MID for IDs; copy the example and verify it.
map.示例：按地区和月份汇总销售额。: Example: total sales by region and month.
map.假设 A2:A5 是地区（East/West/East/North）、B2:B5: Assume A2:A5 holds regions (East/West/East/North), B2:B5 holds months and C2:C5 holds sales. To total East in Jan: =SUMIFS(C2:C5,A2:A5,"East",B2:B5,"Jan"), expected result 300. Replace the three ranges with your own columns; if your list separator is a semicolon, replace the commas with ;.
map.示例统一用逗号作列表分隔符；Windows 区域设置使用分号时，Excel 会要: Examples use a comma as the list separator. When Windows regional settings use semicolons, Excel expects ; as the argument separator.
map.语法模板里的中文占位（如「查找值」「区域」）不能直接执行，必须换成单元格或实际值: Chinese placeholders in syntax templates such as “lookup value” or “range” are not executable; replace them with cells or real values. Only the example formula is copy-ready.
map.XLOOKUP 需要 Microsoft 365 或 Excel 2021+；F: XLOOKUP requires Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021+. FILTER, UNIQUE and SORT require a dynamic-array-capable 365/2021+ build; older versions return #NAME?.
map.动态数组公式下方要留空，否则可能显示 #SPILL!；复制示例前先确认目标区域没: Leave blank cells below a dynamic-array formula or you may see #SPILL!. Confirm the target area is empty before copying.
map.搜索、筛选和复制全部在当前浏览器中完成，不记录搜索词、不写入历史、不上传服务器；: Search, filtering and copying run only in this browser. Search terms are not recorded, written to history or uploaded; refreshing clears the input. The CSV contains only the current filtered results and is generated locally.
map.在顶部搜索框输入函数名或用途关键词（如 VLOOKUP、查找、条件计数），支持中: Type a function name or usage keyword (such as VLOOKUP, lookup or conditional count) into the search box; Chinese and English and leading/trailing spaces are supported. Category buttons also filter. The result count is shown, and no-result states offer clear and suggested keywords.
